questions: If there are multiple ways to group the 1s into a contiguous block, do we need to choose the final position that minimizes total swaps, or can we pick any target block?
Are we allowed to swap any adjacent pair, or only those where at least one character is a 1?
Should we count each swap as one operation even if it moves a 1 past multiple 0s in separate steps?
If there are multiple 1s, can they be moved in any order, or must we preserve their relative order?
Is the goal to minimize swaps such that all 1s are contiguous, or to also minimize the length of the contiguous block (i.e., no extra 0s inside)?
Do we need to output the minimum number of swaps, or can we output any number that achieves contiguity?
If two 1s are separated by zeros, can we move them simultaneously via different swaps, or are operations sequential?
Should we consider that swapping two 0s is allowed but irrelevant, or is there any reason to do so?
